xlsx_recover.title: An export into the linked workbook was interrupted
xlsx_recover.both: The export stopped between moving the previous workbook aside and putting the new one in place. Nothing is lost: the new workbook is complete at {part}, the previous one is kept at {bak}.
xlsx_recover.part_only: The export stopped before the new workbook was put in place. It is complete at {part}.
xlsx_recover.bak_only: The export stopped before the new workbook was ready. The previous workbook is kept at {bak}.
xlsx_recover.finished: The interrupted export is finished: the new workbook is in place.
xlsx_recover.finished_kept: The interrupted export is finished: the new workbook is in place, the previous one is kept at {bak}.
xlsx_recover.restored: The previous workbook is back in place.
xlsx_recover.restore_failed: The previous workbook could not be moved back ({err}). It is kept at {path}.
xlsx_recover.not_restored: The new workbook could not be put in place and the previous one could not be moved back. Nothing is lost: the previous workbook is kept at {path}; Synchronize offers to finish or restore.
xlsx_recover.finish_failed: The new workbook could not be put in place ({err}). It stays at {path}.
xlsx_recover.dest_back: A workbook is back at {path}: nothing was moved.
xlsx_recover.nothing: Nothing of the interrupted export is left to move.
